proposal.summary: A cross-site request forgery (CSRF) vulnerability in Jenkins Frugal Testing Plugin 1.1 and earlier allows attackers to connect to Frugal Testing using attacker-specified credentials and to retrieve test IDs and names from Frugal Testing if a valid credential corresponds to the attacker-specified username.
proposal.affected_product: Jenkins Frugal Testing Plugin 1.1 and earlier
proposal.cwe_quote: A cross-site request forgery (CSRF) vulnerability in Jenkins Frugal Testing Plugin 1.1 and earlier allows attackers to connect to Frugal Testing using attacker-specified credentials, and to retrieve test IDs and names from Frugal Testing, if a valid credential corresponds to the attacker-specified username.

PR.quote: allows attackers to connect to Frugal Testing using attacker-specified credentials

C.quote: retrieve test IDs and names from Frugal Testing

proposal.recommended_next_step: Request a patched plugin from the vendor (or disable/uninstall the plugin) and reproduce the CSRF behavior against a test instance to confirm impact and required conditions.
